message.content: The 2.4.1 release went out this morning and customers are already reporting the settings page is blank. We need to roll back the deploy right now.
Agreed, reverting is the right call. I'll rollback the deployment to the 2.4.0 build with the release tooling, then redeploy once we understand the failure.
Make sure the rollback script also purges the CDN cache, otherwise clients keep fetching the broken bundle.
Done. The revert completed, the CDN cache was purged, and the settings page renders again. I tagged the rollback commit so the postmortem can reference the exact deploy we reverted.
